_public_note: Public build manifest. Verbatim retail source strings are stored as SHA-256 digests (fields ending in _sha256); the builder recomputes them from the user's own ROM. Japanese text in this file is written by this project.
description: Editorial localization of s_text 61/16, the six US-only judge missions of the top-61 mission-battle dialogue table (JP 61/16 holds 150 empty records). 144 lines: 54 with no aligned JP entry (visible editorial scope) and 90 that the index-based transfer had overwritten with an empty JP record. Every other top-61 sub-page has JP originals and is produced by source transfer after the stride correction in CONF['text']['align']['s_text'].
block_layout: 24 lines per mission: intro (judge), 6 race variants (Marche/hume/bangaa/nu mou/viera/moogle), 5 special variants (Ezel/Babus/Ritz/Shara/Cid), judge defeat, the same 11 variants for the post-battle line
